items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Did you ever hear that other one, then, with Countess Johnson?

ctx.x: They had a terrific band, too. It didn't groove too much, but it was a swinging band like that. It didn't have much guts in it or something, I don't know. I don't know what that was.
Did you ever hear that other one, then, with Countess Johnson? She died very early, but she sang and played piano about then.
I think Jimmy Hamilton's wife was out there at the time.
